personality: 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT colors and structure with 4 Tactile / Playful surfaces and large radii
personality_one_liner: An elegant, calming, and friendly AI digital twin companion with a playful hand-drawn feel, warm cream tones, and soft floating cards.

spacing.rule: Use 8pt grid system. Generous padding around content to feel calming like Headspace. No dense dashboards.

do's: Use soft, solid surface color layering and Skia organic background shapes instead of glassmorphism to preserve the warm, non-digital, hand-drawn paper feel.
dont's: Avoid heavy blur or glass effects which make the app look like a standard iOS utility or crypto app.

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Introduce the premium AI twin experience with a calm, animated welcome.
screens.layout: Warm cream background (surface). App logo with subtle glow. Center: Robot mascot fading in and gently floating (use Reanimated withRepeat/withSequence for Y-axis floating). Soft particle effects in background (Skia). After 2-3 seconds, premium slide+fade transition to Welcome screen.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: Allow user to choose their initial path without full-width button clutter.
screens.layout: Headline 'Your AI Digital Twin that grows with you' in Nunito. Two large, elevated floating cards (surfaceSecondary) vertically stacked. Card 1: 'Independent Learning'. Card 2: 'Supervised Learning'. Each card features an embedded vector illustration/Skia blob, minimal icon in a colored rounded square, and subtle press scale animation (0.95).

screens.name: RoleSelector
screens.layout: Horizontal bento-style cards or vertical list of rounded cards for Student, Parent, Child. Playful hand-drawn SVG icons for each role.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Login/Signup including invite code logic for children.

states.error: Soft error toast in error color

screens.layout: Single column form. Input fields with large radius (16px), soft beige (surfaceTertiary) backgrounds, no hard borders. Primary CTA is a pill-shaped button.

screens.name: StudentHome

states.empty: Illustration of an open book with soft sage blobs, text 'Ready to learn?'
states.error: Text 'Oops, something went wrong' with retry button

screens.layout: Headspace-inspired layout. Horizontal-scrolling 'Today's Focus' cards (Bento-style). Below, vertical list of upcoming Study Sessions. Floating feature cards with soft organic blob backgrounds (Skia/SVG) and colored rounded square icons. Custom pill-style bottom tab bar.

screens.name: ParentHome

states.empty: Illustration of parent/child silhouette, 'Add your first student'

screens.layout: Top section: Multi-column grid of child profiles (avatars with sage green borders). Middle: Activity feed of recent quiz scores/completed tasks. Bottom Nav: Home, Schedule, Students, Analytics, Profile.

screens.name: ChildHome

states.empty: Robot saying 'No tasks today, time to play!'

screens.layout: Large, tactile touch targets. Prominent robot mascot greeting them. Horizontal list of 'My Quizzes' with colorful mustard/orange cards. Bottom Nav: Home, Tasks, Study, Quiz, Profile.

mascot_placeholder.alt: A cute floating robot to serve as a placeholder for the animated mascot

abstract_blob_placeholder.alt: Soft abstract minimalist shapes to substitute for Skia blobs if needed

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Warm cream background (#FDFBF7), Sage green primary (#9CAF88), Soft orange (#F4A261), Mustard yellow (#E9C46A). Deep espresso (#4A4036) for text.
Typography: Use Nunito for display/headings for that friendly, rounded feel. Use Inter for body text for optimal readability.
Use @shopify/react-native-skia or react-native-svg to create the soft organic blob backgrounds for feature cards. Do NOT rely on PNG images for UI elements.
Splash screen MUST use react-native-reanimated for the floating robot mascot and fading transitions. Create a loop for the floating effect.

Welcome screen MUST NOT have standard full-width CTA buttons. Use large elevated cards (surfaceSecondary) with Skia blob backgrounds, an icon tile, and descriptive text for 'Independent Learning' and 'Supervised Learning'. Implement a scale-down animation (0.95) on press.
Corners must be large (24px for primary cards, 16px for secondary/inputs).
Shadows should be soft and dispersed to emulate floating white paper cards on a cream background.
Implement a custom pill-style bottom tab bar, floating slightly off the bottom safe area with no hard borders.
Layout Inspiration: Treat home screens like Headspace — use horizontal scrolling bento-style cards for 'Today's Focus' and generous whitespace, rather than dense list views.
